result.title: When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models
result.comment: 50 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations). Code: https://github.com/shuhulx/ConceptorComplementGain
result.summary: When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $α=.05$ and gain $β=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\%$--$7.815\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. A geometric aperture sweep shows that the operating regime changes with the filter setting. Separately, an invertible soft filter preserves what an unrestricted affine readout can recover, whereas dedicated erasure methods reduce prediction by newly fitted probes. Together, the results show why a whole-intervention comparison cannot by itself attribute generated behavior to the fitted matrix: analyze the complete transformation, hold shared components fixed, and test its output consequences directly.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在语言模型激活干预中研究行为归因：保持目标中心与增益不变、仅移除概念子补（conceptor complement）拟合的协方差滤波矩阵，用 1920 条响应的配对比较与几何孔径扫描检验该矩阵是否带来额外的目标抑制收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定共享分量、只移除被检验的拟合矩阵、直接检验输出后果」的归因设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容与增益/尺度等成分的贡献分配和因果作用核查提供方法线索，但是否可迁移到多模态推理状态仍需核查。
